claim: TOTP = Time-Based One-Time Password (RFC 6238 title); time-based variant of HOTP; default 30-second time step (§4.1, §5.2)
PKCE = Proof Key for Code Exchange ("pixy"); mitigates the authorization code interception attack via code_verifier / code_challenge (§1)
JWKS = JSON Web Key Set: a JSON object representing a set of JWKs, with a "keys" member that is an array of JWKs (RFC 7517 §2, §5)
base64url = Base 64 Encoding with URL and Filename Safe Alphabet (RFC 4648 §5); differs from base64 in the 62nd/63rd alphabet characters
Bearer token = security token where any party in possession (a "bearer") can use it without demonstrating possession of cryptographic key material (RFC 6750 §1.2)
Certificate Transparency = publicly auditable, append-only logs of issued TLS certificates so anyone can audit CA activity (§1)
RFC 8725 is BCP 225, Category: Best Current Practice, title "JSON Web Token Best Current Practices" (updates RFC 7519)
__Host- cookie prefix: user agent ignores the cookie unless secure-only-flag is true, host-only-flag is true, and Path=/ (draft-ietf-httpbis-rfc6265bis-22 §5.7 step 21); draft expires 4 June 2026

IMDSv2 is session-oriented: session token created with a PUT request to /latest/api/token; token must be included in subsequent GETs; requests without a valid token get 401 when token usage is required
SP 800-63B-4 current edition: published July 2025, supersedes SP 800-63B (CSRC publication landing page)
